title: Selena Gomez & Benny Blanco Tease Summery New Latin Song ‘Te Olvido (La La)’ With Becky G
summary: The track will appear on the producer's upcoming Hermoso album.
contentText:
Three of the most influential names in music are teaming up on the same track, and it already sounds like a contender for song of the summer. In recent social media posts, Selena Gomez and Benny Blanco teased their new collaboration with Becky G , “Te Olvido (La La),” which arrives in just a few days.

In a video shared by the Rare Beauty founder on Tuesday (July 28), Gomez vibes to the track in a casual white tank top with her hair tied back and no makeup on. Swiping over the camera lens with her hand to the breezy Latin pop beat, she seamlessly transitions into full glam, a chic bob and glittering gold dress.

The day prior, her husband and powerhouse producer gave fans the first taste of “Te Olvido.” “POV: ur new song with wifey and becky drops in a few days but but ur the only one in the world who has the mp3,” Blanco wrote over a snippet of the song, which features the women’s vocals singing “Oh la la la la” in a catchy refrain.

“Can’t believe I’m on this song and you haven’t sent me the mp3,” Becky G commented on the post.

Arriving Friday (July 31), “Te Olvido (La La)” comes ahead of Blanco’s new album, Hermoso . The August-slated eight-track project also features previously released singles “Degenere” with Myke Towers and “Joven y Salvaje” with Bb Trickz.

Becky G also has a new album coming soon. Featuring 17 new songs — including singles “EPA,” which reached No. 47 on Hot Latin Songs , and “Marathon” featuring Elkan — Baraja Bendita arrives on Aug. 14. The set will follow 2024’s Encuentros , which peaked at No. 15 on the Top Latin Albums chart.
